thread:
elaine: Quick sync — trying to lock the final hero lines for Host / Dedicated / Private pages before tomorrow's launch post. Need copy + routing decisions in one thread.

mike: Thanks. Can you paste current variants?

elaine: P1 Host: "Hosted API — production LLMs with simple pricing"
P2 Dedicated: "Reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput"
P3 Private: "On-prem & VPC deployments for regulated workloads"

ana: Those read like features. Can we make them outcome-first? e.g., Host -> "Start fast, scale predictably"; Dedicated -> "Consistent latency for mission-critical flows"; Private -> "Enterprise control and compliance"

jamal: +1 on outcomes. For the launch post we should emphasize benchmarks in the hero subhead, e.g., "<10ms median for short prompts" is risky though. Maybe use relative phrasing: "Latency-optimized for production apps"

elaine: Good point. We have benchmark narratives scheduled for Monday — can't claim exact ms in hero. Ana, can you draft new short lines? 8 words max each.

ana: Sure. Drafts:
Host: "Go from prototype to production in hours"
Dedicated: "Throughput you can budget for, latency you can trust"
Private: "Control, auditability, and on-prem performance"

mike: Those are cleaner. Now routing: webinar registration should be its own funnel. Two followups from marketing: 1) Webinar registrants (educational nurture) 2) Enterprise leads (sales SDR) 3) Self-serve signups (product)

luis: For forms, add a hidden field `lead_route` and values: `webinar`, `enterprise`, `selfserve`. Also include `utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch`. Example hidden inputs: <input type="hidden" name="lead_route" value="webinar">

elaine: Nice. Where should demo requests from Hosted pages route? Historically Hosted has higher self-serve intent. Suggest mapping: Hosted -> selfserve, Dedicated -> enterprise, Private -> enterprise. Webinar CTA appears across all pages but with contextual copy.

jamal: Agree but allow an override if user checks "talk to sales" — then route enterprise. Also we should tag source_page: `hosted|dedicated|private` for segmentation.

ana: For the hero CTA text: Hosted: "Try the Hosted API" (primary) + "Watch launch webinar" (secondary). Dedicated: "Request capacity demo" + "Watch launch webinar". Private: "Get a private demo" + "Watch launch webinar".

mike: Can product ops wire the tracking? @luis can you add the hidden fields to the live forms and push a simple GTM event: `tri_mode_cta_click` with label=page_type?

luis: On it. I'll add fields + GTM event today and drop the tag in /product-analytics.

elaine: Webinar planning notes: we want a short 25-min product + 15-min Q&A. Slide outline: 1) Why serving matters (latency/cost SLOs) 2) Demo: Hosted quickstart + Dedicated capacity panel + Private security checklist 3) Benchmarks overview (methodology callout) 4) Customer stories 5) CTA / next steps.

ana: For the benchmarks slide we must include methodology: dataset, avg sequence length, model family, and a note: "results vary by model & workload". Keep one small chart, not raw tables.

mike: Marketing deliverables: copy finalization (ana) by EOD, forms+tracking (luis) by 5pm, webinar page + registration flow (elaine) by EOD, launch post draft (mike) by tomorrow 10am.

elaine: I'll consolidate final hero/subheads into the copy doc after Ana's pass and ping design for hero lock. If anyone sees legal/compliance flags for the Private page wording, @jamal pls flag.

deploy-bot: Reminder: content freeze for landing pages at 2023-11-15 18:00 UTC.

mike: Noted. Thanks everyone — let's keep this thread as the single source for copy + routing decisions.
